;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni Civil War]], [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**The [[Saudi Arabia]]n-led coalition declares a unilateral [[ceasefire]] in its military action against [[Houthi movement|Houthi forces]] in [[Yemen]]. The ceasefire, which supports [[United Nations|UN]] efforts to end the five-year-old war,  will be effective Thursday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-52224358 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Use of chemical weapons in the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons]] finds there are "reasonable grounds to believe" that the [[Syrian Air Force]] was responsible for three [[chemical weapon]] attacks in March 2017 that affected 106 people in the opposition-held village of [[Al-Lataminah]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-52221323 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Following a collapse in print sales amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], ''[[The Jewish Chronicle]]'' and ''[[Jewish News]]'' [[newspaper]]s enter voluntary liquidation and are to close. [https://www.theguardian.com/media/2020/apr/08/jewish-chronicle-and-jewish-news-to-be-liquidated-and-staff-laid-off (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cyclone Harold]]
**[[Cyclone Harold]] hits [[Fiji]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/04/07/Deadly-tropical-cyclone-bears-down-on-Fiji-islands/2261586297301/ (UPI)]
*[[Caprigliola bridge collapse]]
**A bridge between the towns of Caprigliola and Albiano Magra in [[Tuscany]], [[Italy]], collapses. It results in only minor injuries of two truck drivers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52213898 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/08/lockdown-keeps-casualty-figure-low-as-italian-bridge-collapses (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/04/08/world/europe/bc-eu-italy-bridge-collapse.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****China ends the [[2020 Hubei lockdowns|lockdown in Wuhan]], as controls on outbound travel in [[Wuhan]] are officially lifted just after Tuesday midnight. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/07/world/asia/wuhan-coronavirus.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****Prince and governor of [[Riyadh Region]] [[Faisal bin Bandar Al Saud (born 1945)|Faisal bin Bandar Al Saud]] is admitted to an intensive care unit after testing positive for COVID-19. It's reported that at least 150 members of the [[House of Saud|royal family]] have been infected. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/coronavirus-widespread-saudi-royal-family-report-200409070130026.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 936 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 7,095. [https://metro.co.uk/2020/04/08/uk-coronavirus-death-toll-rises-nearly-1000-day-12527392/ (''Metro'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Malta]] reports its first death from COVID-19, a 92-year-old woman with underlying health problems, as total cases rise to 299. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-malta/malta-records-its-first-coronavirus-death-idUSKCN21Q349 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Somalia]]
****Somalia reports its first death from COVID-19 as the cases reach 12. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-somalia/somalia-has-registered-first-death-from-coronavirus-health-minister-idUSKCN21Q2L6?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] becomes the third state to surpass 20,000 cases of COVID-19, after [[New York (state)|New York]] and [[New Jersey]]. As of this date, Michigan has 20,346 confirmed cases with 959 deaths. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/04/michigan-becomes-3rd-state-to-eclipse-20000-coronavirus-cases.html (MLive.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] Governor [[Andrew Cuomo]] reports 779 more deaths from COVID-19 in the state, the highest daily death toll in the state to date, bringing its death toll to 6,268, with 149,316 total cases. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20200409_22/ (NHK)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Sultan of Oman]], [[Haitham bin Tariq]], pardons 599 prisoners, including 336 foreigners. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-oman-prisoners/oman-sultan-pardons-599-prisoners-including-336-foreigners-oman-news-agency-idUSKBN21Q0QR (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] suspends his [[Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]], leaving former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] as the [[presumptive nominee]] of the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] for President in the [[2020 United States presidential election|general election]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52219756 (BBC News)]
